nature Electrical
  potential Voltage v "V" abstol 1e-6
  flow Current i "A" abstol 1e-12
body Diode
  param is: f64 = 1e-14 where (is > 0.0)
  param n: f64 = 1.0 where (n > 0.0)
  param cj0: f64 = 0.0 where (cj0 >= 0.0)
  node a: Electrical port
  node k: Electrical port
  branch b0 (a, k) flow
  limit L0 "vd"
  local id: f64
  local new: f64
  local nvt: f64
  local old: f64
  local vcrit: f64
  local vd: f64
  analog
    let nvt = (n * vt(if temperature_given() { temperature() } else { 300.15 }))
    let vcrit = (nvt * ln((nvt / (sqrt(2.0) * is))))
    let vd = limit L0 (probe(a, k), |new, old| pnjlim(new, old, nvt, vcrit), seed vcrit)
    let id = (is * (exp((vd / nvt)) - 1.0))
    b0.flow +> direct (id + (gmin() * vd)), ddt (cj0 * vd)
body DiodeSeries
  node vin: Electrical signal
  node a: Electrical signal
  node b: Electrical signal
  child v1: Vsource  nodes (vin, gnd)  params (dc = 5.0)
  child r1: Resistor  nodes (vin, a)  params (r = 1000.0)
  child d1: Diode  nodes (a, b)  params (is = 1e-14, n = 1.0)
  child d2: Diode  nodes (b, gnd)  params (is = 1e-14, n = 1.0)
body Resistor
  param r: f64 where (r > 0.0)
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) flow
  analog
    b0.flow +> direct (probe(p, n) / r)
body Vsource
  param dc: f64 = 0.0
  param ac: f64 = 0.0
  node p: Electrical port
  node n: Electrical port
  branch b0 (p, n) potential
  stim S0 "ac"
  analog
    b0.potential +> direct ((dc * source_scale()) + ac_stim S0 (ac))
fn pnjlim(new: f64, old: f64, nvt: f64, vcrit: f64) -> f64
  local arg: f64
  local arg: f64
  local new: f64
  local nvt: f64
  local old: f64
  local vcrit: f64
  if ((new > vcrit) && (abs((new - old)) > (2.0 * nvt))) { if (old > 0.0) { let arg = ((new - old) / nvt); if (arg > 0.0) { (old + (nvt * (2.0 + ln((arg - 2.0))))) } else { (old - (nvt * (2.0 + ln((2.0 - arg))))) } } else { (nvt * ln((new / nvt))) } } else { if (new < 0.0) { let arg = if (old > 0.0) { ((-old) - 1.0) } else { ((2.0 * old) - 1.0) }; if (new < arg) { arg } else { new } } else { new } }
fn vt(t: f64) -> f64
  local t: f64
  ((1.380649e-23 * t) / 1.602176634e-19)
instance DiodeSeries: DiodeSeries  nodes (DiodeSeries.vin, DiodeSeries.a, DiodeSeries.b)  params ()  top
instance DiodeSeries.v1: Vsource  nodes (DiodeSeries.vin, gnd)  params (dc = 5.0, ac = 0.0)
instance DiodeSeries.r1: Resistor  nodes (DiodeSeries.vin, DiodeSeries.a)  params (r = 1000.0)
instance DiodeSeries.d1: Diode  nodes (DiodeSeries.a, DiodeSeries.b)  params (is = 1e-14, n = 1.0, cj0 = 0.0)
instance DiodeSeries.d2: Diode  nodes (DiodeSeries.b, gnd)  params (is = 1e-14, n = 1.0, cj0 = 0.0)
node DiodeSeries.a: Electrical  declared by DiodeSeries
node DiodeSeries.b: Electrical  declared by DiodeSeries
node DiodeSeries.vin: Electrical  declared by DiodeSeries
